verdict_text: NO. The MLP regex accepts any numeric layer index instead of restricting layers to `0..15`. Consequently, an incorrect key set containing 64 matching tensors from the wrong layers could pass `merged == 64`, violating the requirement to merge exactly the specified 64 tensors and verify all others as shared.
